messages:
leah park: Heads-up: were publishing a focused migration guide for the v1->v2 API and an associated localized FAQ. Plan: freeze docs snippets Thurs 12pm PT, soft publish Fri for internal review, public announce Mon.
omar rizvi: I can own the localization passes (FR/DE/JP). Will need final copy by Thurs AM to hit the timeline. Also we should include short bullet points per locale, not full longform.
ryan taylor: SDKs will land a rename and an alias. Well add a CLI flag for the index-migration tool: `--preserve-dims` and `--dry-run`. Can docs include a step-by-step for the tool and an example output?
sara nguyen: Yes. Adding an example output + explanation of metrics to watch (index size, avg vector length, top-k recall). Also adding a note on embed dim mismatch and how to detect it: quick curl check + expected error code 422.
leah park: Good. For the localized FAQ, keep the "what breaks" table small: endpoints, snippet changes, embed dim delta, expected errors, rollback steps. Also add a short section for "canary customers" — who to ping for assisted migration.
omar rizvi: Can we add a small human readable migration checklist at top for non-dev readers? 3 bullets: backup indexes, run index-migration with --dry-run, verify recall and fallback mapping.
ryan taylor: Will supply the CLI sample and an SDK snippet. Proposed CLI snippet: ```bash
redwood-migrate index --from redwood-embed-v1 --to redwood-embed-v2 --dry-run 
# output: plan.json with list of affected indices
```
sara nguyen: Sample curl smoke test for embed dim mismatch: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v2","input":["test"]}' | jq .
# if dims mismatch you'll see {"error": {"code":422, "message":"vector dimension mismatch"}}
```
dev-doc-bot: docs-ci: PR #4021 (migration/localize/faq) opened by @leah-park  lint ok, spellcheck flagged 2 FR strings.
leah park: @omar will you take the FR strings? I can address the DE/JP later today. Also tagging @ryan for the CLI output example so we can paste real output into the guide.
omar rizvi: Taking FR strings now. I'll mark TODOs inline and submit a small follow-up PR if needed.
ryan taylor: Pushed example output in PR comments. Note: we sanitize customer IDs in examples.
sara nguyen: Ops question: during canary, can Dedicated keep v1 pinned for specific tenants? Ops said yes for 30 days if requested; add that to the rollback section.
leah park: Perfect. Last ask: add a short "how we will communicate" section (docs banner, changelog entry, in-product toast for web console, pre-deprecation emails to pinned tenants). I'll draft the banner copy and drop it in the PR.
dev-doc-bot: docs-ci: PR #4021 build passed on staging; preview link: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/migration/v1-to-v2-preview
leah park: Thanks team — I'll merge once localization passes and @ryan confirms CLI output. Will ping here when public announce is scheduled. :rocket:
